paragraphs: The official Roblox description identifies three parts of the experience: cook ramen, record yourself eating it, and work toward becoming a successful mukbang creator. It does not document every interface control, cash formula, or gamepass effect.

paragraphs: Take a reading of your cash display, if present, immediately before beginning a session and again after completing the in-game video workflow. That observation answers more than an unsupported 'best recipe' claim.
If your cash changes at multiple moments, record each moment separately. Do not credit an entire increase to cooking alone when another reward, pass or bonus may also have been active.

sections.intro: The fastest method cannot be established without measured in-game results. Start with a controlled baseline that any player can repeat.

subsections.heading: Compare equal conditions
paragraphs: With a time value in minutes, observed cash-change rate is (C2 − C1) / minutes. This is a measurement you can calculate, not a published game guarantee.
Compare at least three runs with and without a single adjustment. Note whether a pass, promotion, reward streak or server update could be affecting the outcome.
